sheet_name: ตารางเสา C1,CN1,CN2,CX / รายละเอียดการเสริมเหล็กปลอกในเสา
source_image: image/บ้าน_เล็ก_2ชั้น_06/บ้าน_เล็ก_2ชั้น_06_หน้า40.png
warnings: The ตารางเสา has ONE data column headed 'C2,C5,C9,C10,C12' — all five marks share the same section and rebar at every level. Expanded here into one element per mark per level (5 x 3 = 15 rows) so a takeoff can group by mark; the sheet itself prints the data once. Column marks are named after the footing they sit on (C2 on F2, C5 on F5, and so on).

'C6' is MISSING from this schedule. Both foundation plans (S-02/หน้า29 and S-03/หน้า30) put a column C6 at E2, on F6 / F1.00x1.00, but the table header reads only 'C2,C5,C9,C10,C12'. C6's own section and rebar are therefore not given anywhere in this extraction — not assumed to match the others. Same flag already carried on both footing-plan files.

The top row of the table (คานอะเส down to พื้นชั้น 2) contains only an upward ditto arrow, meaning 'as the row below'. So the floor2-to-ring-beam segment is recorded as the same 0.20x0.20 / 4ø20มม section as the floor1-to-floor2 segment, and each of those five rows carries a flag saying the value came from the arrow rather than from its own printed cell.

The table prints the tie as 'ปø6มม' with NO spacing, and the sheet's own หมายเหตุ says 'ระยะห่างของเหล็กปลอก ให้ดูรายละเอียดการเสริมเหล็กปลอกในเสา' — the spacing comes from the elevation detail at the right of the sheet. That detail gives, per storey: ties @0.10 over a 0.50m zone at each end of the column, and @0.20 through the middle, which is also marked 'ระยะการต่อเหล็ก' (the lap-splice zone); the first tie sits 0.05m clear of each beam face. Recorded on every C-mark element as spacing_mm null + variable_spacing true with that note, rather than picking one number.

CN1, CN2 and CX are drawn as standalone 1:20 sections beside the table, each with its own printed tie spacing (@0.075) — those are NOT governed by the variable-spacing detail and carry a real spacing_mm. Their extent notes are printed verbatim: CN1 'ขึ้นจากชั้น 1 – ถึงชานพัก', CN2 'ขึ้นจากชั้น 2 – ถึง+6.65ม', CX 'ขึ้นจากอะเส – ถึงโครงหลังคา'. Note the CN2 and CX captions both print the mark as plain 'CN' in the parenthetical.
Bar-type convention: ø6มม and ø9มม recorded as 'RB' (plain round), ø12มม and larger as 'DB' (deformed). The sheet prints only 'ø'.

The sheet title block reads 'ตารางเสา C1,CN1,CN2,CX' but no mark 'C1' appears anywhere on the sheet or on either foundation plan — the title-block text is kept verbatim in sheet_name and 'C1' is treated as a title-block error, not a sixth column type.
